notes.title: 🎉 Cursed Dawn release date announcement! 🎉
notes.content:
Cursed Dawn Release Date Announcement!
Lock & Load, Survivors—Your Nightmare Awaits!

[hr][/hr]

April 7, 2025
The world has fallen to the zombies, one munch at a time. Reduced to a handful of hardened survivors, humanity’s final stand begins in Cursed Dawn—a round-based horror FPS where every shot is precious and death lurks behind every corner. How long can you endure the onslaught?

[hr][/hr]

What Is Cursed Dawn?
Cursed Dawn thrusts you into decaying, zombie-infested battlegrounds. Maps are packed with secrets to uncover, traps to spring, and just enough firepower to keep you alive—if you think strategically and shoot straight.


[]Dynamic Spawns: No playthrough is ever the same. The undead crash in from every angle the second you let your guard down.
[]Secrets & Surprises: Scour every inch of each map for hidden codes, special weapons, and unexpected ways to survive.
[]Solo or Co-Op Mayhem: Brave the darkness alone, or team up with a friend to send the undead back to the grave—one gory chunk at a time.


[hr][/hr]

[center][previewyoutube=zx_K-h_WFdM;full][/previewyoutube][/center]
Official Release Date Trailer
Just how deep does the horror run? Check out the trailer:
(Watch on YouTube)

[hr][/hr]

A Closer Look at the Carnage
Arsenal of Weapons & Physics: From trusty shotguns to experimental energy rifles—wield 20+ weapons. Or get creative: blow zombies into the air by triggering explosive chain reactions that turn the undead horde into a grisly bowling match.

Open-Ended Strategic Gameplay: Quick reflexes might keep you alive for a short while, but real survivors think ahead—memorize the map, prioritize targets, and move fast. One wrong turn can land you in a dead-end corridor with no escape.

A Gory World: Battle for your life across a sprawling slaughterhouse, an eerie museum, the claustrophobic halls of a high-security prison, and the ancient catacombs. Your surroundings can be the key to survival—or your final resting place.


[hr][/hr]

Join the Community
Stay connected with fellow survivors, discuss strategies, and keep up with development updates.
Join Our Discord

[hr][/hr]

Wishlist & Prepare
[olist]
[]Wishlist on Steam
[]Mark April 7, 2025—the day the horde descends.
Tell us in the comments—how will you outlive the apocalypse?
[/olist]

[hr][/hr]

Will you conquer the cursed dawn or join the ever-growing ranks of the undead? The clock is ticking, survivor—make every bullet count.

notes.title: Cursed Dawn is Live for Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Cursed Dawn is Live for Steam Next Fest!

Hey survivors,
We’re excited to announce that Cursed Dawn is officially part of Steam Next Fest, running from October 14th at 10 AM PDT to October 21st. Even better, Cursed Dawn's demo is already live and ready for you to experience.

Demo Highlights
This exclusive demo features one of the upcoming maps, currently in its development stage, giving you a first look at the intense survival mechanics and intricate secrets hidden throughout the prison.
Can you survive the relentless zombie onslaught, or will you fall before the horde overwhelms you?

[hr][/hr]

Limited Time Only
The demo will be available for the duration of Steam Next Fest, so don’t miss out! Dive into the action, survive as long as you can, and let us know your feedback. Your thoughts are crucial in helping us refine and improve the final release.

Wishlist Cursed Dawn Now!
If you enjoy the chaos, don’t forget to wishlist Cursed Dawn and be the first to know about the latest updates.

[hr][/hr]

Join the Conversation

Follow us on TikTok
Join our Discord for more info and updates


Thank you for your support, and we can’t wait to see how long you can survive the apocalypse!

notes.title: Official Publisher Announcement
notes.content:
Uniting Forces in the Apocalypse

Greetings, survivors! Today marks a thrilling new chapter for Cursed Dawn, as I proudly announce our partnership with Freedom Games. This collaboration isn't just news; it's a transformative step for us. As a solo developer, teaming up with Freedom Games propels our journey forward in ways I had only dreamed of.

For those of you who may not know, having a game publisher like Freedom Games greatly helps indie developers focus on game development while they handle all the behind-the-scenes magic. From helping manage store pages to crafting marketing campaigns and even helping the game shine at both digital and live events, publishers help in all the aspects that indie developers often struggle with. This partnership means Cursed Dawn will not only reach its full potential but also connect with more of you out there, waiting for the next game to challenge and excite you.

Why Freedom Games?

Choosing Freedom Games came down to their deep understanding of indie games and their dedication to helping creators succeed. Their expertise and passion mean they’re not just a publisher; they’re a partner who's as invested in Cursed Dawn’s success as I am. With their support, I’m free to pour my heart and soul into making this game everything we’ve imagined it could be—and more.

Gratitude and Invitation

Your support has always been the cornerstone of Cursed Dawn. With Freedom Games by our side, our community is set to grow and thrive even more. 

I invite you to join us on this exciting journey:
- **Discord**: Join the conversation and be part of our growing community.
- **Follow Us**: Stay up-to-date with all things Cursed Dawn:
    - TikTok: @curseddawngame

Don’t forget to check out other great indie titles on Freedom Games’ Steam Publisher Page. Also, please remember to wishlist Cursed Dawn and join our Discord community to be notified of future announcements!

Thank you for being an essential part of this journey,

Cursed Studios
